notes_for_editor: Thin record. The Central US Lookouts Meadows page has only a heading and agency line. Status and coordinates come from the Forest Fire Lookout Association county list; the TopoZone entry gives the name and USGS quad only, with no date. The story is about 90 words, below the 120-word floor, because no source we could reach describes the tower's history. A Texas Forest Service history or the Gregg County Historical Museum archive would be the next places to look. Access and staffing are left out.
